message.content: {"scores":{"c1":7,"c2":6,"c3":9},"evidence":"Word count is about 85, which is above the ~65-word target but within the threshold, so c3 takes only a small deduction. c3 also loses for \"учебно методическую\", which is missing its hyphen. c1: Most claims are supported. Defects: the summary refers to \"Авторы\" although the text speaks of a single author. \"медиаграмотность уже стала главным принципом национальной политики\" overstates the source, which only quotes a Finnish motto. \"интеграции соответствующей дисциплины в школьную программу\" is an acceptable paraphrase of \"обязательная часть общего образования\". c2: The problem is covered: protectionism, post-truth and fakes. The method is covered in general terms: definitions and examples. Proposals are covered: the vertical and Finland. Omitted: the decline in trust in the media (25%, 22→34%), the specific infodemic case, the PR campaign, libraries, and the absence of a state programme."}
